card.name: The word symptom(s) in warnings
card.fires_on: The word "symptom" or "symptoms" in label warnings, especially after "signs or" or "timing of", or at the start of an "If symptoms persist" clause.

modes.label: Signs or symptoms present
modes.description: "symptoms" after "such signs or" in a hypersensitivity warning, followed by an instruction to stop the drug or evaluate the patient.
modes.example: If such signs or<< symptoms>> are present, discontinue ketorol

modes.label: Symptom onset or persistence
modes.description: "symptom" or "symptoms" where the text goes on to discuss onset or whether they persist.
modes.example: If<< symptoms>> persist despite holding or slowing the infusion,

card.writes: It nudges the model toward words about how long symptoms last, such as persists, lasting and duration.
card.plain: It marks the word symptom(s) in a warning, where the next words are likely to say how long the symptoms last or persist.
